# agentcss

> A mobile-web CSS component library with a machine-readable contract: 40 components,
> design tokens (light/dark), RTL and forced-colors support. No build step, no framework,
> zero third-party runtime dependency. **Class names are the API.**

Query the contract instead of guessing:

- `ai/components.json` — id, tier, maturity, root class, slots, variants, states, ARIA, file paths
- `ai/pitfalls.json` — known failure modes, keyed by component
- `ai/pitfalls-writing.json` — failure modes of prose/demos/publishing (no component key)
- `ai/tokens.json` · `ai/tokens.tree.json` — DTCG tokens, light + dark
- `ai/behaviors.json` — five behaviour cores (Esc / focus return / roving / typeahead / scroll lock)

## CLI (works without installing)

```bash
npx agentcss ai components --json                    # all 40 components
npx agentcss ai components --json --maturity=stable  # only stable
npx agentcss ai tokens --json --set=dark
npx agentcss ai pitfalls --json --component=table
npx agentcss ai validate ai/components.json --schema=components --json
npx agentcss ai check page.json --profile=strict --json
```

Every subcommand accepts `--json`. On failure it prints
`{"ok":false,"command":"…","error":{"kind":"…","message":"…"}}` and exits non-zero,
so a pipeline can never mistake an error for data.

`pitfalls` needs `agentcss@0.21.0+`: `npx` resolves the *published* version, which can lag
this repository. If a subcommand is missing, check `npx agentcss --version` first.

There is **no MCP server**: the CLI is the whole interface (read-only queries, no daemon,
no second copy of the contract to keep in sync). See `ai/START-HERE.md` §7.

## Use it in a page

1. `<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/agentcss/dist/01-tokens/tokens.css">`
2. add `typography.css` / `page.css` only if you use the page skeleton
3. add the component's own CSS, then copy its markup from `demo.html`
4. restyle with tokens (CSS variables); do not rewrite component selectors

## Rules that prevent most breakage

- **Copy markup from `demo.html`** — it is the ground truth, not the prose.
- 44×44 px minimum touch target; `:focus-visible` only, never `outline: 0`.
- Every state must stay readable without colour — forced-colors drops backgrounds.
- Tables and other wide content need their own scroll container.
- Behaviour (drawer / tabs / overlay) needs its JS; the CSS alone is not interactive.

`README.md` (English) · `ai/START-HERE.md` (Chinese navigation) · `llms-full.txt` (one-page reference with every component).

**Language:** prose docs (component READMEs, demos) are Chinese; JSON keys, CLI flags and this file are English.
